table.retrieve:
SELECT   
	purledger.purinvcode,   
	purledger.purcatcode,
	purledger.purtypecode,
	purledger.printbalance,
	purledger.suppinvdate,
	purledger.grn,
	aliasname=accounts.aliasname,
	purledger.suppcode,   
	purledger.custcode,
	purledger.suppinvcode,
	purledger.pocode,   
	purledger.salesmancode,   
	purledger.date,   
	purledger.discperc,   
	purledger.flatdisc,   
	purledger.misccharges,   
	misccharges1=dbo.purledger.misccharges1,   
	misccharges2=dbo.purledger.misccharges2,   
	misccharges3=dbo.purledger.misccharges3,   
	misccharges4=dbo.purledger.misccharges4,   
	misccharges5=dbo.purledger.misccharges5,   
	purledger.salestax,   
	purledger.posted,   
	purledger.postdate,   
	purledger.remarks, 
	purledger.invtotal,  
	users.username,   
	supplier.address1,   
	supplier.city,   
	supplier.phone,   
	NTN=supplier.ntnno,
	podate=Getdate(),   
	posupplierreference=SPACE(100),   
	manfname='                                        '  ,   
	manfcode=0,
	purledger.originaldate,
	purledger.modifiedby,
	purledger.postedby,
	purledger.porb,
	purledger.headerno,
	gcode=0,
	suppbalance=0.00,
	creditordebit=' ',
	dbo.purledger.purinvpagesize,
	purledger.invgstperc1,
	dbo.purledger.headerinvno,
	dbo.purledger.AccountFor,
	dbo.purledger.PaymentMode,
	dbo.purledger.PaymentAccCode,
	dbo.purledger.Amt,
	dbo.purledger.AmtBy,
	dbo.purledger.AmtDate,
	dbo.purledger.AmtReference,
	dbo.purledger.Outstandingamt,
	dbo.purledger.marked,
	dbo.purledger.currencycode,
	dbo.purledger.conversionfactor,
	dbo.purledger.AssociatedSaleOrderCode,
	dbo.purledger.AssociatedSaleInvCode,
	dbo.purledger.GCCode,
	dbo.purledger.Vehicle,
	dbo.purledger.ShipTo,
	dbo.purledger.NewPurchaseOrderNo,
	dbo.purledger.LCNo,
	dbo.purledger.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate,
	dbo.purledger.ImpactInventory,
	dbo.purledger.advancetax,
	dbo.purledger.AdvanceTaxAmt,
	dbo.purledger.CreditDays,
	dbo.purledger.icatcode,
	dbo.purledger.monthlycounter,
	dbo.purledger.dailycounter,
	dbo.purledger.SuppInvAmount,
	dbo.purledger.QE1_AccCode, 
	dbo.purledger.QE2_AccCode, 
	dbo.purledger.QE3_AccCode, 
	dbo.purledger.QE4_AccCode, 
	dbo.purledger.QE5_AccCode, 
	dbo.purledger.WE1_AccCode, 
	dbo.purledger.WE2_AccCode, 
	dbo.purledger.WE3_AccCode, 
	dbo.purledger.WE4_AccCode, 
	dbo.purledger.WE5_AccCode,
	dbo.purledger.QExp1_CrAccCode, 
	dbo.purledger.QExp2_CrAccCode, 
	dbo.purledger.QExp3_CrAccCode, 
	dbo.purledger.QExp4_CrAccCode, 
	dbo.purledger.QExp5_CrAccCode, 
	dbo.purledger.WExp1_CrAccCode,
	dbo.purledger.WExp2_CrAccCode, 
	dbo.purledger.WExp3_CrAccCode, 
	dbo.purledger.WExp4_CrAccCode, 
	dbo.purledger.WExp5_CrAccCode,
	dbo.PurLedger.TaxCategoryCode,
	dbo.PurLedger.SiteCode,
	dbo.PurLedger.TargetSiteCode
	
FROM 
	purledger,   
	users,   
	supplier,
	accounts  
WHERE
	( dbo.purledger.ImpactInventory= 'Y' ) AND 
	( purledger.suppcode = supplier.suppcode ) and  
	( purledger.suppcode = accounts.acccode )  and
	( purledger.salesmancode = users.usercode) and  
	( ( dbo.purledger.purinvcode = :r_InvCode ) )
